exception_categories.name: surface_alias_only
exception_categories.description: Prediction differs from gold only by approved alias normalization or script variant.

exception_categories.name: boundary_ambiguous_span
exception_categories.description: A span can reasonably be attached to either a parameter or constraint boundary without changing semantics.

exception_categories.name: timestamp_timezone_inferred
exception_categories.description: Prediction preserves the timestamp value but omits or infers timezone details not explicit in the source text.

exception_categories.name: numeric_unit_equivalence
exception_categories.description: Prediction uses an approved unit alias or equivalent surface form covered by normalization rules.

exception_categories.name: unsupported_hallucinated_field
exception_categories.description: Prediction adds unsupported extracted content not grounded in the source text.
